title: What Is a Machine Learning Research Paper?

cues.en: Welcome back.
cues.zh: 歡迎回來。

cues.en: And the last video we left on the cliffhanger of a question, What is a machine learning research paper?
cues.zh: 上支影片最後，留下什麼是機器學習研究論文這個問題。

cues.en: Now, rather than talk about this out loud, let's actually have a look at one.
cues.zh: 與其口頭討論，不如實際看一篇。

cues.en: So if we go here, this is the VIT paper or the vision transformer paper formerly titled An Image is
cues.zh: 這是 ViT，或者 Vision Transformer 論文，正式標題是 An Image Is

cues.en: worth 16 by 16 words Transformers for image recognition at scale.
cues.zh: Worth 16 × 16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale。

cues.en: And of course, if you don't understand anything of what's going on here, feel free to pause the video and search it up.
cues.zh: 當然，如果有不懂的地方，隨時暫停影片搜尋。

cues.en: What is a transformer machine learning?
cues.zh: 什麼是機器學習 Transformer？

cues.en: Transformer machine learning model.
cues.zh: Transformer 機器學習模型。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 有了。

cues.en: We've got transformers.
cues.zh: Transformers。

cues.en: We have a transformer is a deep learning model that adopts the mechanism of self attention that's really important.
cues.zh: Transformer 是採用自注意力機制的深度學習模型，這很重要。

cues.en: So a convolutional neural network will use a convolutional layer, but a transformer is typically an architecture that uses self attention.
cues.zh: 卷積神經網路用卷積層，而 Transformer 通常是使用自注意力的架構。

cues.en: And if you want to learn more about that, you can read up on that as its main learning mechanism.
cues.zh: 想多了解，可以閱讀，那是它主要的學習機制。

cues.en: So we're going to be focused on building a transformer with PyTorch code rather than talking about the nitty gritty of what each layer actually does.
cues.zh: 所以會專注用 PyTorch 建立 Transformer，而不細談每層實際做什麼。

cues.en: So differentially weighting the significance of each part of the input data.
cues.zh: 對輸入資料各部分的重要性，賦予不同權重。

cues.en: It is used primarily in the fields of natural language processing NLP.
cues.zh: 主要用於自然語言處理，NLP。

cues.en: In fact, that's where transformers were first introduced and computer vision, which is what we're going to be doing.
cues.zh: 其實 Transformer 最早在這裡引入；也用於電腦視覺，就是接下來要做的。

cues.en: We're going to be using a vision transformer.
cues.zh: 會使用 Vision Transformer。

cues.en: So a transformer for computer vision.
cues.zh: 電腦視覺的 Transformer。

cues.en: I'll let you read more up on that if you like.
cues.zh: 想要可以自己多讀。

cues.en: This is a machine learning research paper.
cues.zh: 這就是機器學習研究論文。

cues.en: And if we just scroll through this, we have an abstract which gives a little overview of one paragraph.
cues.zh: 往下看，有 Abstract，摘要，一段話概述。

cues.en: We have an introduction which may be talk about what the problem is and what previous research has done and what this paper suggests they could try and do.
cues.zh: 有 Introduction，導論，可能談問題是什麼、先前研究做什麼，以及本篇建議嘗試什麼。

cues.en: Oh, there's related work.
cues.zh: 哦，有 Related Work。

cues.en: Okay, so there's some related work to the problem then.
cues.zh: 與問題相關的工作。

cues.en: We have a lot of figures.
cues.zh: 有很多圖。

cues.en: Sometimes we describe a model with visuals rather than just text, because I know for me I really understand things in a visual format.
cues.zh: 有時用視覺而非只有文字描述模型，因為對我來說，視覺形式很容易理解。

cues.en: Then we have method, we have a vision transform of it that describes the architecture, which is four main equations, because remember machine learning models in PyTorch, neural network layers and all
cues.zh: 然後 Method，有 Vision Transformer，ViT，描述架構，主要四個方程式；因為記得 PyTorch 機器學習模型、神經網路層，

cues.en: that sort of jazz behind the hood are running some sort of mathematical function.
cues.zh: 這些背後都在執行某種數學函數。

cues.en: We have a whole bunch of different sections, experiments set up, what data sets we use, what hyper parameters were used.
cues.zh: 有許多不同小節，實驗設定、使用資料集、超參數。

cues.en: Now there's a lot of information here.
cues.zh: 資訊很多。

cues.en: And so what you need to and I'm going to stress this throughout the course, is that this was written by 12 researchers, so some of the smartest people in the world collaborated to create this research
cues.zh: 所以需要，我會整門課強調，這是 12 位研究人員寫的，一群世界上最聰明的人合作，建立這份研究，

cues.en: paper.
cues.zh: 論文。

cues.en: So it makes sense if for the first time I've read this about half a dozen times now, and there are still some things that I don't understand.
cues.zh: 所以第一次看不懂很正常；我已讀了大約六次，仍有些不懂。

cues.en: So for your extra curriculum for this video is to read through this once.
cues.zh: 本支影片延伸學習，就是讀過一次。

cues.en: It may take you a couple of hours when you first begin.
cues.zh: 剛開始可能花幾小時。

cues.en: But if you're interested in getting involved in machine learning research, you're going to be reading quite a few of these and it takes a bit of practice to begin with.
cues.zh: 如果想參與機器學習研究，會讀很多篇，一開始要練習。

cues.en: But once you practice like anything, you get better and better.
cues.zh: 不過像任何事情，練習之後會越來越好。

cues.en: So with that being said, we've looked at one single paper, but let's get a high level overview of the anatomy of a research paper and in fact many other kinds of scientific papers.
cues.zh: 所以看過一篇論文後，來概述研究論文的結構，其實其他許多科學論文也類似。

cues.en: So we might have a number of different sections here.
cues.zh: 這裡可能有不同章節。

cues.en: And what each of those sections contains, often machine learning, research papers and other scientific papers will begin with an abstract.
cues.zh: 每節包含什麼？機器學習與其他科學論文，通常從 Abstract 開始。

cues.en: Now, there might be different names for these, but I've just chosen some of the most generic ones and the ones that I've personally used and the ones that I'm most familiar with.
cues.zh: 名稱可能不同，我只是挑一些最通用、我自己用過、最熟悉的。

cues.en: So we have an abstract which gives an overview summary of the papers, main findings and contributions and interaction.
cues.zh: Abstract 概述主要發現與貢獻；再 Introduction。

cues.en: What's the main problem in our case?
cues.zh: 主要問題是什麼？

cues.en: For the Vision transformer, it might be image recognition.
cues.zh: Vision Transformer 的例子，可能是影像辨識。

cues.en: So if we go back for image recognition at scale, in other words, image classification, just like what we're doing with Food Vision Mini.
cues.zh: 回去看，Image Recognition at Scale，換句話說，影像分類，就像 FoodVision Mini。

cues.en: So if we come back here, we have method or in a bit transformer paper.
cues.zh: 回這裡，有 Method，或者 ViT 論文，

cues.en: It says experiments.
cues.zh: 寫 Experiments。

cues.en: So what steps did the researchers take?
cues.zh: 研究人員採取什麼步驟？

cues.en: This is a lot like a cooking recipe.
cues.zh: 很像烹飪食譜。

cues.en: What's the method to reproduce the dish?
cues.zh: 重現菜餚的方法是什麼？

cues.en: What's the method to reproduce the machine learning research findings?
cues.zh: 重現機器學習研究發現的方法是什麼？

cues.en: What were the results?
cues.zh: 結果如何？

cues.en: Did the paper achieve better than other similar papers, or did it find something new?
cues.zh: 成果比類似論文更好，還是發現新事物？

cues.en: What's the conclusion?
cues.zh: 結論是什麼？

cues.en: So what's the next direction for research?
cues.zh: 下一個研究方向？

cues.en: If the research was to inspire other research, where should we look next?
cues.zh: 如果研究要啟發其他研究，接下來該往哪裡？

cues.en: References.
cues.zh: References，參考文獻。

cues.en: So machine learning, research papers and in fact, a lot of scientific research in general is built off the basis of previous scientific research.
cues.zh: 機器學習論文，其實一般很多科學研究，都是建立在先前研究基礎上。

cues.en: So if we look here, these are all the references that the Vision transformer paper is quoting.
cues.zh: 看這裡，全部是 Vision Transformer 論文引用的文獻。

cues.en: So these are all research papers in themselves.
cues.zh: 各自也都是研究論文。

cues.en: So there's about maybe 50, 60, 60 odd other research papers that this research paper has borrowed
cues.zh: 所以大約 50、60，六十多篇其他論文，這篇從中借用，

cues.en: ideas from.
cues.zh: 概念。

cues.en: So if we see here, there's one here in the model design, we follow the original Transformer, Vaswani et al, 2017.
cues.zh: 看這裡，模型設計遵循原始 Transformer，Vaswani 等人，2017。

cues.en: Now this is, I believe the attention is all you need paper.
cues.zh: 我想這是 Attention Is All You Need。

cues.en: So if we have a look at this, this is a little bit of a treasure trial.
cues.zh: 看看，開始熟悉機器學習研究與發表後，就像能一路往下找的，

cues.en: You can start to go down once you get familiar with machine learning research and how it's published.
cues.zh: 尋寶路徑。

cues.en: Attention is all you need.
cues.zh: Attention Is All You Need。

cues.en: Now.
cues.zh: 現在，

cues.en: Did this introduce the transformer?
cues.zh: 這篇引入 Transformer 嗎？

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 有了。

cues.en: We propose a new simple network architecture, the transformer.
cues.zh: 「我們提出新的簡單網路架構，Transformer。」

cues.en: So this is where the transformer that you may have heard architecture is very popular at the moment was first introduced.
cues.zh: 這就是你可能聽過、目前很熱門的 Transformer 架構，首次提出的地方。

cues.en: Attention is all you need way back in 2017, which is five years ago now.
cues.zh: Attention Is All You Need，早在 2017 年，距現在五年。

cues.en: I'm recording this in 2022.
cues.zh: 我在 2022 年錄製。

cues.en: So in deep learning terms, this is quite an old paper because things change quickly.
cues.zh: 對深度學習而言，相當舊，因為變化很快。

cues.en: But it turns out the transformer is very capable.
cues.zh: 不過 Transformer 證明很有能力。

cues.en: So not only can it perform on natural language processing, it can perform on vision data sets.
cues.zh: 不只自然語言處理，也能處理視覺資料集。

cues.en: And so this one is a little bit more recent, 3rd of June 2021.
cues.zh: 所以這篇比較新，2021 年 6 月 3 日。

cues.en: So if we come back here finally, it might finish off with an appendix, and in the appendix you might have extra resources and findings to look at that weren't included in any of the above sections.
cues.zh: 回來，最後可能有 Appendix，附錄，放前面章節沒包含的額外資源與發現。

cues.en: And as this little asterisk says, this is a fluid structure, right?
cues.zh: 如這個星號說的，這個結構是彈性的，對吧？

cues.en: It's more of a general guide than a rigid outline.
cues.zh: 比起嚴格大綱，更像通用指南。

cues.en: So you might find the names of some sections chopped and changed and you might find that they might have extra sections.
cues.zh: 所以章節名稱可能調整，也可能加額外章節。

cues.en: But this is pretty stock standard for any general machine learning research paper.
cues.zh: 不過這是一般機器學習論文相當標準的樣貌。

cues.en: And so we go to the next slide.
cues.zh: 下一張投影片。

cues.en: So this is just that table we looked at before, but condensed.
cues.zh: 這是之前表格的濃縮版。

cues.en: So if we just draw some colorful lines here and colorful boxes, you can see that the paper, the paper that we've been looking at has an abstract to begin with and then an introduction.
cues.zh: 畫些彩色線與框，就能看到這篇論文先有 Abstract，再 Introduction。

cues.en: So again, we're going to be specifically focusing on the vision transformer paper itself in this section.
cues.zh: 同樣，本章特別專注 Vision Transformer 論文本身。

cues.en: But a lot of what we're talking about, the principles of turning a paper into usable code and different
cues.zh: 不過，談到如何把論文轉成可用程式，以及不同，

cues.en: research sections can be drawn or lines can be drawn from that to many other different types of machine learning research papers.
cues.zh: 研究章節的原理，也能套用到許多其他機器學習研究論文。

cues.en: Of course, the individual steps may be different, but the overall principles are much the same.
cues.zh: 當然個別步驟可能不同，但整體原理很像。

cues.en: So let's keep going.
cues.zh: 所以繼續。

cues.en: We've talked about what a machine learning research paper is, but why would we want to replicate a machine learning research paper?
cues.zh: 談過什麼是機器學習論文，但為什麼要重現它？

cues.en: Well, let's talk about that in the next video.
cues.zh: 下支影片討論。
